name: Pre-Seed / Seed Startup
description: For pre-seed and seed-stage startups with 1-10 people. Founder-led and flat — everyone wears multiple hats, no formal departments exist yet. Best suited for companies validating product-market fit before their first institutional round.

org_structure.overview: The seed-stage org is intentionally flat and role-based rather than department-based. Every person operates across functional boundaries, and reporting lines are direct to the CEO. The philosophy is maximum velocity: decisions are made by the person closest to the problem, communication is synchronous and informal, and structure is avoided until it creates a bottleneck. Titles are secondary to ownership areas.

departments.name: Founding Team
departments.description: The core founding group that sets vision, builds the product, finds first customers, and raises capital. In a seed startup the 'department' is just the company itself — all roles listed here constitute the entire org.

roles.title: CEO / Co-Founder
roles.description: Sets overall vision, strategy, and culture. Owns fundraising, hiring, and external communications. Ultimately accountable for all outcomes.

roles.title: CTO / Co-Founder
roles.description: Owns the technical vision and architecture. Builds the initial product alongside the engineering team and makes all technical decisions. Often ships code daily.

roles.title: Product Lead
roles.description: Defines product strategy, prioritizes roadmap, conducts user research, and writes specs. At seed stage this may be the CEO or CTO wearing a second hat.

roles.title: Full-Stack Engineer
roles.description: Builds features across the entire stack. Expected to own features end-to-end from database schema to UI. Works directly with the CEO/CTO on priorities.

roles.title: Marketing Lead
roles.description: Owns brand, messaging, content, and demand generation. Often runs paid acquisition, social media, and PR. May be a fractional or part-time hire at this stage.

roles.title: Sales Lead
roles.description: Owns the sales process from pipeline generation through close. Handles early customer relationships and feeds product feedback into roadmap. May also serve as customer support.

key_relationships: CEO and CTO meet daily for a 15-minute sync to align on product, hiring, and fundraising priorities.
Everyone attends a weekly all-hands standup — no information silos are tolerated at this stage.
Marketing and Sales sit together (often the same person) to ensure messaging consistency from first touch through close.
Every engineer has a direct line to customer feedback — engineers join sales calls regularly.
Decision-making is consultative but ultimately the CEO decides. The motto is 'disagree and commit.'

CEO/Founder
├── CTO/Co-Founder
│   └── Full-Stack Engineers (2-4)
├── Product Lead (may be CEO or CTO dual hat)
├── Marketing Lead
└── Sales Lead
